notes.title: Overwhelmingly Positive v2.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Thanks to all of your support, we've reached the milestone of 500 reviews, achieving the title of "Overwhelmingly Positive" with a 98% approval ratio!

To commemorate, we're releasing v2.0 of the game! The most important update is the new support for high refresh-rates, so you can now enjoy doing your favorite yoyo tricks at 120 Hz and higher!

Here's the complete list of changes:

Adds support for high refresh-rate monitors, together with a new setting to display the current frame-rate as an overlay.

Adds functionality to the oracle to reveal diamonds, and also adds a screen making it clear when you've sold them all.

Makes it so enemies will continue to drop money when retrying a room.

Implements several gameplay improvements to many rooms and bosses, including a new checkpoint during the final boss.

Fixes the completion percentage when playing in New Game+.

notes.title: v1.5 Update
notes.notes:
Fixes "Solo" commands while holding items (configurable via Command Mapping settings). For example, executing a "Solo" Offstring Throw while holding an item now works as intended and launches the item with the yoyo.
 Includes minor gameplay improvements to various rooms.

notes.title: v1.4 Update
notes.notes:
Adds a new option to oracle Mnelia to reveal unvisited rooms (after beating the game's story). Visiting these rooms is important to reach 100% game completion.
 Fixes oracle Mnelia failing to reveal missing Badges/Containers under certain circumstances.
 Improves the interaction between pigeons and popcorn.
 Makes it so the timer in some timed challenges will respect the Game Speed accessibility setting.
 Improves Wall-Ride's grip on wall corners when using the Badge that increases its speed.
 Includes minor gameplay improvements to various rooms.

notes.title: v1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Adds a "Borderless Full Screen" option to the Graphics Settings.
 Adds a "Restore Defaults" button to the Difficulty Settings, and makes it so altered settings are highlighted.
 Makes it so the game continues to load even if you switch focus to another window.
 Changes the negative effect of the first Upgrade Contract.
 Includes minor gameplay improvements to various rooms.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Prepare for your first Yoyovania adventure! Pipistrello & The Cursed Yoyo is releasing May 28,2025! 

It is also releasing for consoles on the same day! Thank you for following Pipit and family on the journey to release! We'll see you there!
